offering_description.value: Develops, manufactures and sells generic injectable and inhalation drugs, plus diagnostic products, to hospitals, wholesalers and pharmacies. Makes products in its own US plants and markets them under its own and partner labels.

primary_products.value: injectable generic drugs; inhalation products; nasal naloxone; diagnostic kits

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, wholesalers, pharmacies, group purchasing organizations; B2C: consumers buying over-the-counter asthma inhaler at pharmacies

revenue_model.value: product sales: injectables, inhalers and diagnostic kits sold to wholesalers and hospitals

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes injectables and inhalers from purchased active ingredients, sold to wholesalers and hospitals; brand owner: markets own branded over-the-counter inhaler and generic drugs sold to pharmacies and hospitals

geography_served.value: US national: nationwide across the United States, with some sales in other countries

specialization.value: related lines: injectable drugs, inhalation products and diagnostic kits

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: national drug wholesalers; third-party retail: retail pharmacies selling over-the-counter products; direct sales: direct supply contracts with hospitals and group purchasing organizations
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA approval of generic and over-the-counter drugs, plus FDA good manufacturing practice rules
